inductive MemoryBlockState
| free
| allocated
| entangled
| migrating
deriving Repr, BEq, Inhabited

def MemoryBlockState.toUInt8 (s : MemoryBlockState) : UInt8 :=
  match s with
  | .free => 0
  | .allocated => 1
  | .entangled => 2
  | .migrating => 3

def MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8 (u : UInt8) : Option MemoryBlockState :=
  match u with
  | 0 => some .free
  | 1 => some .allocated
  | 2 => some .entangled
  | 3 => some .migrating
  | _ => none

theorem MemoryBlockState_toUInt8_ofUInt8 (s : MemoryBlockState) :
  (MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8 (s.toUInt8)) = some s := by
  cases s <;> simp [MemoryBlockState.toUInt8, MemoryBlockState.ofUInt8]

def ByteArray.lt (a b : ByteArray) : Bool :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) : Bool :=
    if i < a.size && i < b.size then
      if a[i]! < b[i]! then true
      else if a[i]! > b[i]! then false
      else loop (i + 1)
    else a.size < b.size
  loop 0

instance : LT ByteArray where
  lt := ByteArray.lt

instance : Ord ByteArray where
  compare a b :=
    if ByteArray.lt a b then .lt
    else if ByteArray.lt b a then .gt
    else .eq

instance : DecidableRel (fun a b : ByteArray => a < b) := fun a b =>
  match compare a b with
  | .lt => isTrue (by decide)
  | _ => isFalse (by decide)

def MemoryBlock.addEntangledBlock (self : MemoryBlock) (other : ByteArray) : MemoryBlock :=

  { self with entangled_blocks := self.entangled_blocks.erase other }

def writeU64Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Nat) : ByteArray :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (x : Nat) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < out.size then
      let b := (x &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
      loop (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b)
    else arr
  loop 0 v out

def writeI128Little (out : ByteArray) (v : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let ux := v.toNat.toUInt128
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (x : UInt128) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < out.size then
      let b := x.toUInt8
      loop (i + 1) (x >>> 8) (arr.set! i b)
    else arr
  loop 0 ux out

def bytesToHexLower (out : ByteArray) (input : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (arr : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < input.size then
      let b := input[i]!
      let hi := (b >>> 4).toNat
      let lo := (b &&& 0xF).toNat
      let h := if hi < 10 then '0'.toNat + hi else 'a'.toNat + (hi - 10)
      let l := if lo < 10 then '0'.toNat + lo else 'a'.toNat + (lo - 10)
      loop (i + 1) (arr.set! (2 * i) h.toUInt8 |>.set! (2 * i + 1) l.toUInt8)
    else arr
  loop 0 out

def sha256_rotateRight (x : UInt64) (n : Nat) : UInt64 :=
  let n' := n % 64
  (x >>> n') ||| (x <<< (64 - n'))

def sha256_ch (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z)
def sha256_maj (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)
def sha256_sigma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 2 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 13 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 22
def sha256_sigma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 6 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 11 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 25
def sha256_gamma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 7 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3)
def sha256_gamma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 17 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def sha256_prepare_w (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0:UInt64)
  for i in [:16] do
    w := w.set! i chunk[i]!
  let mut j := 16
  while j < 64 do
    let s0 := sha256_gamma0 (w[j-3]!)
    let s1 := sha256_gamma1 (w[j-8]!)
    let val := (w[j-16]! + s0 + w[j-7]! + s1).toUInt64
    w := w.set! j val
    j := j + 1
  termination_by 64 - j
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
  w

def sha256_transform (state : Array UInt64) (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let w := sha256_prepare_w chunk
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (a b c d e f g h : UInt64) : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 :=
    if i < 64 then
      let s1 := sha256_sigma1 e
      let ch := sha256_ch e f g
      let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + (sha256_k i).toUInt64 + w[i]!
      let s0 := sha256_sigma0 a
      let maj := sha256_maj a b c
      let temp2 := s0 + maj
      loop (i + 1) (temp1 + temp2) a b c d (d + temp1) e f
    else (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
  termination_by 64 - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
  let (na, nb, nc, nd, ne, nf, ng, nh) := loop 0 state[0]! state[1]! state[2]! state[3]! state[4]! state[5]! state[6]! state[7]!
  #[na + state[0]!, nb + state[1]!, nc + state[2]!, nd + state[3]!, ne + state[4]!, nf + state[5]!, ng + state[6]!, nh + state[7]!]

def sha256 (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let init := #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19].map (λ x => x.toUInt64)
  let ml := data.size * 8
  let padded_len := ((data.size + 8 + 64) / 64) * 64
  let mut padded := Array.mkArray padded_len (0:UInt8)
  for i in [:data.size] do
    padded := padded.set! i data[i]!
  padded := padded.set! data.size 0x80
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 8) ((ml >>> 56).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 7) ((ml >>> 48).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 6) ((ml >>> 40).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 5) ((ml >>> 32).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 4) ((ml >>> 24).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 3) ((ml >>> 16).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 2) ((ml >>> 8).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 1) ((ml >>> 0).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (st : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
    if i < padded_len / 64 then
      let chunk := Array.mkArray 16 (0:UInt64)
      let mut c' := chunk
      for j in [:16] do
        let idx := i * 64 + j * 4
        let v := (padded[idx]!.toUInt64 <<< 24) ||| (padded[idx+1]!.toUInt64 <<< 16) ||| (padded[idx+2]!.toUInt64 <<< 8) ||| padded[idx+3]!.toUInt64
        c' := c'.set! j v
      let st' := sha256_transform st c'
      loop (i + 1) st'
    else st
  termination_by (padded_len / 64) - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
    
  let final_state := loop 0 init
  let mut res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 32 0)
  for i in [:8] do
    let v := final_state[i]!
    res := res.set! (4*i) ((v >>> 24) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+1) ((v >>> 16) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+2) ((v >>> 8) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+3) ((v >>> 0) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  res

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let full := sha256 data
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0)
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then loop (i + 1) (acc.set! i full[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  loop 0 res

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16) 0)
  let rec1 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec1 (i + 1) (acc.set! i content_hash[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  let buffer := rec1 0 buffer
  let buffer := writeI128Little buffer timestamp
  let hash_out := sha256 buffer
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
  let rec2 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then rec2 (i + 1) (acc.set! i hash_out[i]!) else acc
  termination_by BLOCK_ID_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  rec2 0 res

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : StorageMap
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (allocator : Allocator) (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    content_index := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    affinity_map := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    total_capacity := cap
    used_capacity := 0 }

def unlinkEntanglements (storage : StorageMap) (block_id : ByteArray) (entangled : BlockIdSet) : StorageMap :=
  let rec loop (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc : StorageMap) : StorageMap :=
    if iter.isEmpty then acc
    else
      let other_id := iter.getMin!.1
      let acc' := match acc.find? other_id with
        | some block =>
            let new_block := block.removeEntangledBlock block_id
            let final_block := if new_block.entangledCount == 0 && new_block.state == .entangled then { new_block with state := .allocated } else new_block
            acc.insert other_id final_block
        | none => acc
      loop (iter.erase other_id) acc'
  termination_by iter.size
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
  loop entangled storage

def ContentAddressableStorage.removeBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let new_storage := unlinkEntanglements self.storage block_id block.entangled_blocks
      let final_storage := new_storage.erase block_id
      let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => let s' := set.erase block_id in if s'.isEmpty then none else some s' | none => none) block.content_hash
      let new_affinity := match block.affinity_core with
        | some core => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => let s' := set.erase block_id in if s'.isEmpty then none else some s' | none => none) core
        | none => self.affinity_map
      let new_used := if self.used_capacity >= block.size then self.used_capacity - block.size else 0
      { self with storage := final_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := new_used }
  | none => self

def evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (required_free : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let entries := self.storage.fold (fun acc id block => acc ++ [block]) []
  let sortFn (a b : MemoryBlock) :=
    if a.state.toUInt8 == 2 && b.state.toUInt8 != 2 then false 
    else if a.state.toUInt8 != 2 && b.state.toUInt8 == 2 then true
    else if a.access_count != b.access_count then a.access_count < b.access_count
    else a.last_access_time < b.last_access_time
  let sorted := entries.mergeSort sortFn
  let rec iter (l : List MemoryBlock) (current : ContentAddressableStorage) (freed : Nat) (pass : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
    if freed >= required_free then current
    else match l with
    | [] => if pass == 0 then iter sorted current freed 1 else current
    | b :: rest =>
        if pass == 0 && b.state.toUInt8 == 2 then iter rest current freed pass
        else
          match current.storage.find? b.block_id with
          | none => iter rest current freed pass 
          | some _ =>
              let sz := b.size
              let new_storage := current.removeBlock b.block_id
              iter rest new_storage (freed + sz) pass
  termination_by (2 - pass, l.length)
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    try simp
    try simp
  iter sorted self 0 0

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit (ContentAddressableStorage × ByteArray) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  let data_size := data.size
  if data_size > self.total_capacity then Except.error () else
  let self := if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then
    let need := (self.used_capacity + data_size) - self.total_capacity
    evictLeastUsed self allocator need
  else self
  if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then Except.error () else
  let (self, block_id) : ContentAddressableStorage × ByteArray := match self.content_index.find? content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
      let rec find_valid (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc_stale : List ByteArray) : Option ByteArray × List ByteArray :=
        if iter.isEmpty then (none, acc_stale) else
        let id := iter.getMin!.1
        match self.storage.find? id with
        | some _ => (some id, acc_stale)
        | none => find_valid (iter.erase id) (id :: acc_stale)
      termination_by iter.size
      decreasing_by
         simp_wf
         apply Nat.sub_pos
         apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
      let (found, stale) := find_valid existing_blocks []
      let new_index := stale.foldl (fun idx sid => idx.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.erase sid) | none => none) content_hash) self.content_index
      let self := { self with content_index := new_index }
      match found with
      | some id =>
          let block := self.storage.find? id |>.get!
          let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
          ({ self with storage := self.storage.insert id updated_block }, id)
      | none => 
          let id := computeBlockId content_hash time
          let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator id content_hash data preferred_core time
          let new_storage := self.storage.insert id block
          let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) content_hash
          let new_affinity := match preferred_core with | some c => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) c | none => self.affinity_map
          ({ self with storage := new_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size }, id)
  | none =>
      let id := computeBlockId content_hash time
      let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator id content_hash data preferred_core time
      let new_storage := self.storage.insert id block
      let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) content_hash
      let new_affinity := match preferred_core with | some c => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) c | none => self.affinity_map
      ({ self with storage := new_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size }, id)
  Except.ok (self, block_id)

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
      let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id updated_block
      some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let block1 := self.storage.find? block_id1
  let block2 := self.storage.find? block_id2
  match block1, block2 with
  | some b1, some b2 =>
      if block_id1 == block_id2 then self
      else
        let nb1 := b1.addEntangledBlock block_id2
        let nb2 := b2.addEntangledBlock block_id1
        let sb1 := { nb1 with state := .entangled }
        let sb2 := { nb2 with state := .entangled }
        let s' := self.storage.insert block_id1 sb1 |>.insert block_id2 sb2
        { self with storage := s' }
  | _, _ => self

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat Nat (fun a b => a < b)) (core_states : Std.RBMap Nat UInt8 (fun a b => a < b)) : Option Nat :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | none => none
  | some block =>
      match block.affinity_core with
      | some core =>
          match core_states.find? core with
          | some state => if state != 2 then some core else none
          | none => none
      | none =>
          let init : Option (Nat × Float) := none
          let res := cores.fold (fun acc cid _ =>
              match core_states.find? cid with
              | some 2 => acc
              | _ =>
                let count : Nat := match self.affinity_map.find? cid with
                  | some core_blocks =>
                      block.entangled_blocks.fold (fun c ebid =>
                        if core_blocks.contains ebid then c + 1 else c
                      ) 0
                  | none => 0
                let distance := 1.0 / (1.0 + Float.ofNat count)
                match acc with
                | none => some (cid, distance)
                | some (bid, min_dist) => if distance < min_dist then some (cid, distance) else acc
            ) init
          res.map Prod.fst

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (target_core : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let am' := match block.affinity_core with
        | some old_core =>
            self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => if (set.erase block_id).isEmpty then none else some (set.erase block_id) | none => none) old_core
        | none => self.affinity_map
      let mb := { block with state := .migrating, affinity_core := some target_core }
      let am'' := am'.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) target_core
      let fb := { mb with state := .allocated }
      let s' := self.storage.insert block_id fb
      { self with storage := s', affinity_map := am'' }
  | none => self

structure TaskDescriptor where
  task_id : ByteArray
  priority : Int
  data_dependencies : List ByteArray
  estimated_cycles : Nat
  assigned_core : Option Nat
  completion_status : Bool
  start_time : Int
  end_time : Int
deriving Repr

def TaskDescriptor.init (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (priority : Int) (est : Nat) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { task_id := task_id
    priority := priority
    data_dependencies := []
    estimated_cycles := est
    assigned_core := none
    completion_status := false
    start_time := 0
    end_time := 0 }

def TaskDescriptor.addDependency (self : TaskDescriptor) (allocator : Allocator) (dep : ByteArray) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { self with data_dependencies := self.data_dependencies ++ [dep] }

def TaskDescriptor.getDuration (self : TaskDescriptor) : Int :=
  if self.completion_status && self.end_time > self.start_time then self.end_time - self.start_time else 0

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool :=
  a.priority > b.priority || (a.priority == b.priority && compare a.task_id b.task_id == .lt)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  active_tasks : Std.RBMap ByteArray TaskDescriptor (fun a b => a < b)
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init (allocator : Allocator) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (time : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 24 0)
  let b1 := writeU64Little buffer self.task_counter
  let b2 := writeI128Little b1 time
  sha256 b2

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × ByteArray :=
  let task_id := self.generateTaskId time
  let task := TaskDescriptor.init allocator task_id priority est
  let task_with_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency allocator d) task
  let new_pending := (task_with_deps :: self.pending_tasks).mergeSort compareTasks
  ({ self with pending_tasks := new_pending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 }, task_id)

structure ProcessingCore where
  core_id : Nat
  state : UInt8 
  cycles_active : Nat
  cycles_idle : Nat
deriving Repr

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { core_id := id, state := 0, cycles_active := 0, cycles_idle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := 1 }
  else
    { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := if self.state == 2 then 2 else 0 }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat self.cycles_active / Float.ofNat total

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b))
    (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × Option (ByteArray × Nat) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => (self, none)
  | task :: rest =>
      let core_states := cores.fold (fun acc cid core => acc.insert cid core.state) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let dummy_map := cores.fold (fun acc cid _ => acc.insert cid cid) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let scores := cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
        if core.state == 2 then acc
        else
          let mut score : Float := 0.0
          for dep in task.data_dependencies do
            if storage.storage.contains dep then
              let nearest := storage.findNearestCore dep dummy_map core_states
              match nearest with
              | some nearest_core =>
                  if nearest_core == cid then score := score + 10.0 else score := score + 1.0
              | none => score := score + 1.0
          let workload := if core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat core.cycles_active / Float.ofNat (core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle)
          score := score + (1.0 - workload) * 5.0
          acc.insert cid score
      ) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      
      if scores.isEmpty then ({ self with pending_tasks := task :: rest }, none)
      else
        let best := scores.fold (fun acc cid sc => if acc.2 < sc then (cid, sc) else acc) (0, -1.0)
        let core_id := best.1
        let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some core_id, start_time := time }
        let new_active := self.active_tasks.insert task.task_id updated_task
        ({ self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := new_active }, some (task.task_id, core_id))

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  match self.active_tasks.find? task_id with
  | none => self
  | some task =>
      let finished := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := time }
      { self with active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase task_id, completed_tasks := finished :: self.completed_tasks }

structure FlowEdgeKey where
  source : ByteArray
  target : ByteArray
deriving Repr, BEq

def compareFlowEdgeKey (a b : FlowEdgeKey) : Ordering :=
  match compare a.source b.source with
  | .lt => .lt
  | .gt => .gt
  | .eq => compare a.target b.target

instance : Ord FlowEdgeKey where
  compare := compareFlowEdgeKey

instance : LT FlowEdgeKey where
  lt a b := compare a b == .lt

instance : DecidableRel (fun a b : FlowEdgeKey => a < b) := fun a b =>
  match compare a b with
  | .lt => isTrue (by decide)
  | _ => isFalse (by decide)

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Std.RBMap ByteArray BlockIdSet (fun a b => a < b)
  flow_weights : Std.RBMap FlowEdgeKey Float (fun a b => a < b)
  access_patterns : Std.RBMap ByteArray (List AccessRecord) (fun a b => a < b)
deriving Repr

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init (allocator : Allocator) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  { flow_graph := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    flow_weights := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    access_patterns := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (block_id : ByteArray) (core_id : Nat) (time : Int) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let rec := AccessRecord.mk time core_id
  let new_patterns := self.access_patterns.alter (fun l => match l with | some list => some (rec :: list) | none => some [rec]) block_id
  { self with access_patterns := new_patterns }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
      let deps := task.data_dependencies
      let rec recDeps (i : Nat) (innerAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
        if i < deps.length then
          let dep1 := deps.get! i
          let rec recJ (j : Nat) (jAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
            if j < deps.length then
              let dep2 := deps.get! j
              if i == j then recJ (j+1) jAcc else
              let fg1 := jAcc.flow_graph.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep2) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep2) dep1
              let fg2 := fg1.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep1) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep1) dep2
              let key := if compare dep1 dep2 == .lt then { source := dep1, target := dep2 } else { source := dep2, target := dep1 }
              let fw := fg2.flow_weights.alter (fun w => match w with | some val => some (val + 1.0) | none => some 1.0) key
              recJ (j + 1) { jAcc with flow_graph := fg1, flow_weights := fw }
            else jAcc
          termination_by deps.length - j
          decreasing_by
             simp_wf
             apply Nat.sub_pos
             linarith
          recDeps (i + 1) (recJ (i + 1) innerAcc)
        else innerAcc
      termination_by deps.length - i
      decreasing_by
         simp_wf
         apply Nat.sub_pos
         linarith
      recDeps 0 acc
    ) self tasks

def DataFlowAnalyzer.analyzeFlow (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (allocator : Allocator) : Std.RBMap Nat Float (fun a b => a < b) :=
  match self.access_patterns.find? block_id with
  | none => Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
  | some accesses =>
      if accesses.length < 2 then Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) else
      let freqs := accesses.foldl (fun acc rec => acc.alter (fun c => match c with | some v => some (v + 1) | none => some 1) rec.core_id) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let total := Float.ofNat accesses.length
      freqs.fold (fun acc cid count => acc.insert cid (Float.ofNat count / total)) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

def DataFlowAnalyzer.getCorrelatedBlocks (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (threshold : Float) (allocator : Allocator) : BlockIdSet :=
  match self.flow_graph.find? block_id with
  | none => Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)
  | some neighbors =>
      neighbors.fold (fun acc nid =>
        let key := if compare block_id nid == .lt then { source := block_id, target := nid } else { source := nid, target := block_id }
        match self.flow_weights.find? key with
        | some w => if w >= threshold then acc.insert nid else acc
        | none => acc
      ) (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b))

structure ChaosCoreKernel where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler
  flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b)
  cycle_count : Nat
  migration_count : Nat
  allocator : Allocator
deriving Repr

def ChaosCoreKernel.init (allocator : Allocator) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { storage := ContentAddressableStorage.init allocator DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE
    scheduler := DynamicTaskScheduler.init allocator
    flow_analyzer := DataFlowAnalyzer.init allocator
    cores := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    cycle_count := 0
    migration_count := 0
    allocator := allocator }

def ChaosCoreKernel.addCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (core_id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with cores := self.cores.insert core_id (ProcessingCore.init core_id) }

def ChaosCoreKernel.allocateMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit (ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray) :=
  match self.storage.store self.allocator data preferred_core time with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (new_storage, block_id) =>
      Except.ok ({ self with storage := new_storage }, block_id)

def ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ChaosCoreKernel) :=
  match self.storage.retrieve block_id time with
  | some (data, new_storage) => some (data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray :=
  let (new_sched, tid) := self.scheduler.submitTask self.allocator priority deps est time
  let tmp_task := TaskDescriptor.init self.allocator tid priority est
  let tmp_task_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency self.allocator d) tmp_task
  let new_analyzer := self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph self.allocator [tmp_task_deps]
  ({ self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer }, tid)

def ChaosCoreKernel.finishTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Bool × ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let new_sched := self.scheduler.completeTask self.allocator task_id time
  let existed := self.scheduler.active_tasks.contains task_id
  (existed, { self with scheduler := new_sched })

def ChaosCoreKernel.entangleData (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with storage := self.storage.entangleBlocks block_id1 block_id2 }

structure Migration where
  id : ByteArray
  target : Nat

def ChaosCoreKernel.optimizeDataPlacement (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let migrations := self.storage.storage.fold (fun acc _ block =>
    if block.state.toUInt8 == 3 then acc else
    let affinities := self.flow_analyzer.analyzeFlow block.block_id self.allocator
    if affinities.isEmpty then acc else
    let best := affinities.fold (fun (b_cid, b_val) cid val => if val > b_val then (cid, val) else (b_cid, b_val)) (0, -1.0)
    let best_core := best.1
    let best_affinity := best.2
    match block.affinity_core with
    | some current => if current != best_core && best_affinity > OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD then { id := block.block_id, target := best_core } :: acc else acc
    | none => acc
  ) []
  let (new_storage, mig_count) := migrations.foldl (fun (st, cnt) mig =>
      let st' := st.migrateBlock mig.id mig.target
      (st', cnt + 1)
  ) (self.storage, self.migration_count)
  { self with storage := new_storage, migration_count := mig_count }

def ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let loads := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core => if core.state == 2 then acc else acc.insert cid core.getWorkload) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
  if loads.isEmpty then self else
  let total := loads.fold (fun s _ v => s + v) 0.0
  let avg := total / Float.ofNat loads.size
  let overloaded := loads.fold (fun acc cid l => if l > avg * LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD then cid :: acc else acc) []
  let underloaded := loads.fold (fun acc cid l => if l < avg * LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD then (cid, l) :: acc else acc) []
  if overloaded.isEmpty || underloaded.isEmpty then self else
  let underloaded_sorted := underloaded.mergeSort (fun a b => a.2 < b.2)
  let under_ids := underloaded_sorted.map Prod.fst
  let (final_storage, final_mig) := overloaded.foldl (fun (st, mig) over_cid =>
      match st.affinity_map.find? over_cid with
      | none => (st, mig)
      | some blocks =>
          let blist := blocks.fold (fun l b => l ++ [b]) []
          if blist.isEmpty then (st, mig) else
          let count := max 1 (blist.length / 4)
          let capped := min count blist.length
          let rec loop (i : Nat) (cur_st : ContentAddressableStorage) (cur_mig : Nat) (u_idx : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage × Nat :=
             if i >= capped then (cur_st, cur_mig) else
             let target := under_ids.get! (u_idx % under_ids.length)
             let next_idx := u_idx + 1
             if target == over_cid then loop (i+1) cur_st cur_mig next_idx else
             let bid := blist.get! i
             let next_st := cur_st.migrateBlock bid target
             loop (i+1) next_st (cur_mig + 1) next_idx
          termination_by capped - i
          decreasing_by
             simp_wf
             apply Nat.sub_pos
             linarith
          loop 0 st mig 0
  ) (self.storage, self.migration_count)
  { self with storage := final_storage, migration_count := final_mig }

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let cycle := self.cycle_count + 1
  let (new_sched, scheduled_info) := self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage time
  let new_analyzer := match scheduled_info with
    | some (tid, cid) =>
        let task := new_sched.active_tasks.find? tid |>.get!
        task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep => acc.recordAccess self.allocator dep cid time) self.flow_analyzer
    | none => self.flow_analyzer
  
  let new_cores := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
      let is_active := match scheduled_info with | some (_, scid) => scid == cid | none => false
      acc.insert cid (core.tick is_active)
    ) self.cores
  
  let temp_kernel := { self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer, cores := new_cores, cycle_count := cycle }
  let k_opt := temp_kernel.optimizeDataPlacement
  if k_opt.cycle_count % BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES == 0 then k_opt.balanceLoad else k_opt

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeGraphOnKernel (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (graph : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let rec_nodes (iter : List (String × Node)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b)) : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b) :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (id, node) :: rest =>
        match acc.1.allocateMemory node.data none time with
        | Except.error _ => rec_nodes rest acc
        | Except.ok (k', bid) => rec_nodes rest (k', acc.2.insert id bid)
  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    case _ => simp

  let (k', node_to_block) := rec_nodes graph.nodes.toList (self, Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

  let rec_edges (iter : List (Edge × Nat)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (edge, _) :: rest =>
        let source_block := node_to_block.find? edge.source
        let target_block := node_to_block.find? edge.target
        match source_block, target_block with
        | some sb, some tb =>
            let k'' := acc.entangleData sb tb
            rec_edges rest k''
        | _, _ => rec_edges rest acc
  termination_by iter.length

def sha256_rotateRight (x : UInt64) (n : Nat) : UInt64 :=
  let n' := n % 64
  (x >>> n') ||| (x <<< (64 - n'))

def sha256_ch (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (~x &&& z)
def sha256_maj (x y z : UInt64) : UInt64 := (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)
def sha256_sigma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 2 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 13 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 22
def sha256_sigma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 6 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 11 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 25
def sha256_gamma0 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 7 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 18 ^^^ (x >>> 3)
def sha256_gamma1 (x : UInt64) : UInt64 := sha256_rotateRight x 17 ^^^ sha256_rotateRight x 19 ^^^ (x >>> 10)

def sha256_prepare_w (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0:UInt64)
  for i in [:16] do
    w := w.set! i chunk[i]!
  let mut j := 16
  while j < 64 do
    let s0 := sha256_gamma0 (w[j-3]!)
    let s1 := sha256_gamma1 (w[j-8]!)
    let val := (w[j-16]! + s0 + w[j-7]! + s1).toUInt64
    w := w.set! j val
    j := j + 1
  termination_by 64 - j
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
  w

def sha256_transform (state : Array UInt64) (chunk : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
  let w := sha256_prepare_w chunk
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (a b c d e f g h : UInt64) : UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 × UInt64 :=
    if i < 64 then
      let s1 := sha256_sigma1 e
      let ch := sha256_ch e f g
      let temp1 := h + s1 + ch + (sha256_k i).toUInt64 + w[i]!
      let s0 := sha256_sigma0 a
      let maj := sha256_maj a b c
      let temp2 := s0 + maj
      loop (i + 1) (temp1 + temp2) a b c d (d + temp1) e f
    else (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
  termination_by 64 - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
  let (na, nb, nc, nd, ne, nf, ng, nh) := loop 0 state[0]! state[1]! state[2]! state[3]! state[4]! state[5]! state[6]! state[7]!
  #[na + state[0]!, nb + state[1]!, nc + state[2]!, nd + state[3]!, ne + state[4]!, nf + state[5]!, ng + state[6]!, nh + state[7]!]

def sha256 (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let init := #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19].map (λ x => x.toUInt64)
  let ml := data.size * 8
  let padded_len := ((data.size + 8 + 64) / 64) * 64
  let mut padded := Array.mkArray padded_len (0:UInt8)
  for i in [:data.size] do
    padded := padded.set! i data[i]!
  padded := padded.set! data.size 0x80
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 8) ((ml >>> 56).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 7) ((ml >>> 48).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 6) ((ml >>> 40).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 5) ((ml >>> 32).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 4) ((ml >>> 24).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 3) ((ml >>> 16).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 2) ((ml >>> 8).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  padded := padded.set! (padded_len - 1) ((ml >>> 0).toUInt64 &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (st : Array UInt64) : Array UInt64 :=
    if i < padded_len / 64 then
      let chunk := Array.mkArray 16 (0:UInt64)
      let mut c' := chunk
      for j in [:16] do
        let idx := i * 64 + j * 4
        let v := (padded[idx]!.toUInt64 <<< 24) ||| (padded[idx+1]!.toUInt64 <<< 16) ||| (padded[idx+2]!.toUInt64 <<< 8) ||| padded[idx+3]!.toUInt64
        c' := c'.set! j v
      let st' := sha256_transform st c'
      loop (i + 1) st'
    else st
  termination_by (padded_len / 64) - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    linarith
    
  let final_state := loop 0 init
  let mut res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 32 0)
  for i in [:8] do
    let v := final_state[i]!
    res := res.set! (4*i) ((v >>> 24) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+1) ((v >>> 16) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+2) ((v >>> 8) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
    res := res.set! (4*i+3) ((v >>> 0) &&& 0xFF).toUInt8
  res

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let full := sha256 data
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate CONTENT_HASH_SIZE 0)
  let rec loop (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then loop (i + 1) (acc.set! i full[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  loop 0 res

def computeBlockId (content_hash : ByteArray) (timestamp : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate (CONTENT_HASH_SIZE + 16) 0)
  let rec1 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < CONTENT_HASH_SIZE then rec1 (i + 1) (acc.set! i content_hash[i]!) else acc
  termination_by CONTENT_HASH_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  let buffer := rec1 0 buffer
  let buffer := writeI128Little buffer timestamp
  let hash_out := sha256 buffer
  let res := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate BLOCK_ID_SIZE 0)
  let rec2 (i : Nat) (acc : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
    if i < BLOCK_ID_SIZE then rec2 (i + 1) (acc.set! i hash_out[i]!) else acc
  termination_by BLOCK_ID_SIZE - i
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
  rec2 0 res

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : StorageMap
  content_index : ContentIndex
  affinity_map : AffinityMap
  total_capacity : Nat
  used_capacity : Nat
deriving Repr

def ContentAddressableStorage.init (allocator : Allocator) (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  { storage := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    content_index := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    affinity_map := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    total_capacity := cap
    used_capacity := 0 }

def unlinkEntanglements (storage : StorageMap) (block_id : ByteArray) (entangled : BlockIdSet) : StorageMap :=
  let rec loop (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc : StorageMap) : StorageMap :=
    if iter.isEmpty then acc
    else
      let other_id := iter.getMin!.1
      let acc' := match acc.find? other_id with
        | some block =>
            let new_block := block.removeEntangledBlock block_id
            let final_block := if new_block.entangledCount == 0 && new_block.state == .entangled then { new_block with state := .allocated } else new_block
            acc.insert other_id final_block
        | none => acc
      loop (iter.erase other_id) acc'
  termination_by iter.size
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    apply Nat.sub_pos
    apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
  loop entangled storage

def ContentAddressableStorage.removeBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let new_storage := unlinkEntanglements self.storage block_id block.entangled_blocks
      let final_storage := new_storage.erase block_id
      let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => let s' := set.erase block_id in if s'.isEmpty then none else some s' | none => none) block.content_hash
      let new_affinity := match block.affinity_core with
        | some core => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => let s' := set.erase block_id in if s'.isEmpty then none else some s' | none => none) core
        | none => self.affinity_map
      let new_used := if self.used_capacity >= block.size then self.used_capacity - block.size else 0
      { self with storage := final_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := new_used }
  | none => self

def evictLeastUsed (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (required_free : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let entries := self.storage.fold (fun acc id block => acc ++ [block]) []
  let sortFn (a b : MemoryBlock) :=
    if a.state.toUInt8 == 2 && b.state.toUInt8 != 2 then false 
    else if a.state.toUInt8 != 2 && b.state.toUInt8 == 2 then true
    else if a.access_count != b.access_count then a.access_count < b.access_count
    else a.last_access_time < b.last_access_time
  let sorted := entries.mergeSort sortFn
  let rec iter (l : List MemoryBlock) (current : ContentAddressableStorage) (freed : Nat) (pass : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
    if freed >= required_free then current
    else match l with
    | [] => if pass == 0 then iter sorted current freed 1 else current
    | b :: rest =>
        if pass == 0 && b.state.toUInt8 == 2 then iter rest current freed pass
        else
          match current.storage.find? b.block_id with
          | none => iter rest current freed pass 
          | some _ =>
              let sz := b.size
              let new_storage := current.removeBlock b.block_id
              iter rest new_storage (freed + sz) pass
  termination_by (2 - pass, l.length)
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    try simp
    try simp
  iter sorted self 0 0

def ContentAddressableStorage.store (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (allocator : Allocator) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit (ContentAddressableStorage × ByteArray) :=
  let content_hash := computeContentHash data
  let data_size := data.size
  if data_size > self.total_capacity then Except.error () else
  let self := if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then
    let need := (self.used_capacity + data_size) - self.total_capacity
    evictLeastUsed self allocator need
  else self
  if self.used_capacity + data_size > self.total_capacity then Except.error () else
  let (self, block_id) : ContentAddressableStorage × ByteArray := match self.content_index.find? content_hash with
  | some existing_blocks =>
      let rec find_valid (iter : BlockIdSet) (acc_stale : List ByteArray) : Option ByteArray × List ByteArray :=
        if iter.isEmpty then (none, acc_stale) else
        let id := iter.getMin!.1
        match self.storage.find? id with
        | some _ => (some id, acc_stale)
        | none => find_valid (iter.erase id) (id :: acc_stale)
      termination_by iter.size
      decreasing_by
         simp_wf
         apply Nat.sub_pos
         apply BlockIdSet.size_erase
      let (found, stale) := find_valid existing_blocks []
      let new_index := stale.foldl (fun idx sid => idx.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.erase sid) | none => none) content_hash) self.content_index
      let self := { self with content_index := new_index }
      match found with
      | some id =>
          let block := self.storage.find? id |>.get!
          let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
          ({ self with storage := self.storage.insert id updated_block }, id)
      | none => 
          let id := computeBlockId content_hash time
          let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator id content_hash data preferred_core time
          let new_storage := self.storage.insert id block
          let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) content_hash
          let new_affinity := match preferred_core with | some c => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) c | none => self.affinity_map
          ({ self with storage := new_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size }, id)
  | none =>
      let id := computeBlockId content_hash time
      let block := MemoryBlock.init allocator id content_hash data preferred_core time
      let new_storage := self.storage.insert id block
      let new_index := self.content_index.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) content_hash
      let new_affinity := match preferred_core with | some c => self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert id) c | none => self.affinity_map
      ({ self with storage := new_storage, content_index := new_index, affinity_map := new_affinity, used_capacity := self.used_capacity + data_size }, id)
  Except.ok (self, block_id)

def ContentAddressableStorage.retrieve (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ContentAddressableStorage) :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let updated_block := block.updateAccessTime time
      let new_storage := self.storage.insert block_id updated_block
      some (block.data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ContentAddressableStorage.entangleBlocks (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  let block1 := self.storage.find? block_id1
  let block2 := self.storage.find? block_id2
  match block1, block2 with
  | some b1, some b2 =>
      if block_id1 == block_id2 then self
      else
        let nb1 := b1.addEntangledBlock block_id2
        let nb2 := b2.addEntangledBlock block_id1
        let sb1 := { nb1 with state := .entangled }
        let sb2 := { nb2 with state := .entangled }
        let s' := self.storage.insert block_id1 sb1 |>.insert block_id2 sb2
        { self with storage := s' }
  | _, _ => self

def ContentAddressableStorage.findNearestCore (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat Nat (fun a b => a < b)) (core_states : Std.RBMap Nat UInt8 (fun a b => a < b)) : Option Nat :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | none => none
  | some block =>
      match block.affinity_core with
      | some core =>
          match core_states.find? core with
          | some state => if state != 2 then some core else none
          | none => none
      | none =>
          let init : Option (Nat × Float) := none
          let res := cores.fold (fun acc cid _ =>
              match core_states.find? cid with
              | some 2 => acc
              | _ =>
                let count : Nat := match self.affinity_map.find? cid with
                  | some core_blocks =>
                      block.entangled_blocks.fold (fun c ebid =>
                        if core_blocks.contains ebid then c + 1 else c
                      ) 0
                  | none => 0
                let distance := 1.0 / (1.0 + Float.ofNat count)
                match acc with
                | none => some (cid, distance)
                | some (bid, min_dist) => if distance < min_dist then some (cid, distance) else acc
            ) init
          res.map Prod.fst

def ContentAddressableStorage.migrateBlock (self : ContentAddressableStorage) (block_id : ByteArray) (target_core : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match self.storage.find? block_id with
  | some block =>
      let am' := match block.affinity_core with
        | some old_core =>
            self.affinity_map.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => if (set.erase block_id).isEmpty then none else some (set.erase block_id) | none => none) old_core
        | none => self.affinity_map
      let mb := { block with state := .migrating, affinity_core := some target_core }
      let am'' := am'.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert block_id) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert block_id) target_core
      let fb := { mb with state := .allocated }
      let s' := self.storage.insert block_id fb
      { self with storage := s', affinity_map := am'' }
  | none => self

structure TaskDescriptor where
  task_id : ByteArray
  priority : Int
  data_dependencies : List ByteArray
  estimated_cycles : Nat
  assigned_core : Option Nat
  completion_status : Bool
  start_time : Int
  end_time : Int
deriving Repr

def TaskDescriptor.init (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (priority : Int) (est : Nat) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { task_id := task_id
    priority := priority
    data_dependencies := []
    estimated_cycles := est
    assigned_core := none
    completion_status := false
    start_time := 0
    end_time := 0 }

def TaskDescriptor.addDependency (self : TaskDescriptor) (allocator : Allocator) (dep : ByteArray) : TaskDescriptor :=
  { self with data_dependencies := self.data_dependencies ++ [dep] }

def TaskDescriptor.getDuration (self : TaskDescriptor) : Int :=
  if self.completion_status && self.end_time > self.start_time then self.end_time - self.start_time else 0

def compareTasks (a b : TaskDescriptor) : Bool :=
  a.priority > b.priority || (a.priority == b.priority && compare a.task_id b.task_id == .lt)

structure DynamicTaskScheduler where
  pending_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  active_tasks : Std.RBMap ByteArray TaskDescriptor (fun a b => a < b)
  completed_tasks : List TaskDescriptor
  task_counter : Nat
deriving Repr

def DynamicTaskScheduler.init (allocator : Allocator) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  { pending_tasks := []
    active_tasks := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    completed_tasks := []
    task_counter := 0 }

def DynamicTaskScheduler.generateTaskId (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (time : Int) : ByteArray :=
  let buffer := ByteArray.mk (List.replicate 24 0)
  let b1 := writeU64Little buffer self.task_counter
  let b2 := writeI128Little b1 time
  sha256 b2

def DynamicTaskScheduler.submitTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × ByteArray :=
  let task_id := self.generateTaskId time
  let task := TaskDescriptor.init allocator task_id priority est
  let task_with_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency allocator d) task
  let new_pending := (task_with_deps :: self.pending_tasks).mergeSort compareTasks
  ({ self with pending_tasks := new_pending, task_counter := self.task_counter + 1 }, task_id)

structure ProcessingCore where
  core_id : Nat
  state : UInt8 
  cycles_active : Nat
  cycles_idle : Nat
deriving Repr

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { core_id := id, state := 0, cycles_active := 0, cycles_idle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (self : ProcessingCore) (is_active : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if is_active then
    { self with cycles_active := self.cycles_active + 1, state := 1 }
  else
    { self with cycles_idle := self.cycles_idle + 1, state := if self.state == 2 then 2 else 0 }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (self : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := self.cycles_active + self.cycles_idle
  if total == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat self.cycles_active / Float.ofNat total

def DynamicTaskScheduler.scheduleTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b))
    (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler × Option (ByteArray × Nat) :=
  match self.pending_tasks with
  | [] => (self, none)
  | task :: rest =>
      let core_states := cores.fold (fun acc cid core => acc.insert cid core.state) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let dummy_map := cores.fold (fun acc cid _ => acc.insert cid cid) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let scores := cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
        if core.state == 2 then acc
        else
          let mut score : Float := 0.0
          for dep in task.data_dependencies do
            if storage.storage.contains dep then
              let nearest := storage.findNearestCore dep dummy_map core_states
              match nearest with
              | some nearest_core =>
                  if nearest_core == cid then score := score + 10.0 else score := score + 1.0
              | none => score := score + 1.0
          let workload := if core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle == 0 then 0.0 else Float.ofNat core.cycles_active / Float.ofNat (core.cycles_active + core.cycles_idle)
          score := score + (1.0 - workload) * 5.0
          acc.insert cid score
      ) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      
      if scores.isEmpty then ({ self with pending_tasks := task :: rest }, none)
      else
        let best := scores.fold (fun acc cid sc => if acc.2 < sc then (cid, sc) else acc) (0, -1.0)
        let core_id := best.1
        let updated_task := { task with assigned_core := some core_id, start_time := time }
        let new_active := self.active_tasks.insert task.task_id updated_task
        ({ self with pending_tasks := rest, active_tasks := new_active }, some (task.task_id, core_id))

def DynamicTaskScheduler.completeTask (self : DynamicTaskScheduler) (allocator : Allocator) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : DynamicTaskScheduler :=
  match self.active_tasks.find? task_id with
  | none => self
  | some task =>
      let finished := { task with completion_status := true, end_time := time }
      { self with active_tasks := self.active_tasks.erase task_id, completed_tasks := finished :: self.completed_tasks }

structure FlowEdgeKey where
  source : ByteArray
  target : ByteArray
deriving Repr, BEq

def compareFlowEdgeKey (a b : FlowEdgeKey) : Ordering :=
  match compare a.source b.source with
  | .lt => .lt
  | .gt => .gt
  | .eq => compare a.target b.target

instance : Ord FlowEdgeKey where
  compare := compareFlowEdgeKey

instance : LT FlowEdgeKey where
  lt a b := compare a b == .lt

instance : DecidableRel (fun a b : FlowEdgeKey => a < b) := fun a b =>
  match compare a b with
  | .lt => isTrue (by decide)
  | _ => isFalse (by decide)

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flow_graph : Std.RBMap ByteArray BlockIdSet (fun a b => a < b)
  flow_weights : Std.RBMap FlowEdgeKey Float (fun a b => a < b)
  access_patterns : Std.RBMap ByteArray (List AccessRecord) (fun a b => a < b)

def DataFlowAnalyzer.init (allocator : Allocator) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=

    flow_weights := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    access_patterns := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.recordAccess (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (block_id : ByteArray) (core_id : Nat) (time : Int) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  let rec := AccessRecord.mk time core_id
  let new_patterns := self.access_patterns.alter (fun l => match l with | some list => some (rec :: list) | none => some [rec]) block_id
  { self with access_patterns := new_patterns }

def DataFlowAnalyzer.buildFlowGraph (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (allocator : Allocator) (tasks : List TaskDescriptor) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
  tasks.foldl (fun acc task =>
      let deps := task.data_dependencies
      let rec recDeps (i : Nat) (innerAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
        if i < deps.length then
          let dep1 := deps.get! i
          let rec recJ (j : Nat) (jAcc : DataFlowAnalyzer) : DataFlowAnalyzer :=
            if j < deps.length then
              let dep2 := deps.get! j
              if i == j then recJ (j+1) jAcc else
              let fg1 := jAcc.flow_graph.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep2) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep2) dep1
              let fg2 := fg1.alter (fun s => match s with | some set => some (set.insert dep1) | none => some (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)).insert dep1) dep2
              let key := if compare dep1 dep2 == .lt then { source := dep1, target := dep2 } else { source := dep2, target := dep1 }
              let fw := fg2.flow_weights.alter (fun w => match w with | some val => some (val + 1.0) | none => some 1.0) key
              recJ (j + 1) { jAcc with flow_graph := fg1, flow_weights := fw }
            else jAcc
          termination_by deps.length - j
          decreasing_by
             simp_wf
             apply Nat.sub_pos
             linarith
          recDeps (i + 1) (recJ (i + 1) innerAcc)
        else innerAcc
      termination_by deps.length - i
      decreasing_by
         simp_wf
         apply Nat.sub_pos
         linarith
      recDeps 0 acc
    ) self tasks

def DataFlowAnalyzer.analyzeFlow (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (allocator : Allocator) : Std.RBMap Nat Float (fun a b => a < b) :=
  match self.access_patterns.find? block_id with
  | none => Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
  | some accesses =>
      if accesses.length < 2 then Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b) else
      let freqs := accesses.foldl (fun acc rec => acc.alter (fun c => match c with | some v => some (v + 1) | none => some 1) rec.core_id) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
      let total := Float.ofNat accesses.length
      freqs.fold (fun acc cid count => acc.insert cid (Float.ofNat count / total)) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

def DataFlowAnalyzer.getCorrelatedBlocks (self : DataFlowAnalyzer) (block_id : ByteArray) (threshold : Float) (allocator : Allocator) : BlockIdSet :=
  match self.flow_graph.find? block_id with
  | none => Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b)
  | some neighbors =>
      neighbors.fold (fun acc nid =>
        let key := if compare block_id nid == .lt then { source := block_id, target := nid } else { source := nid, target := block_id }
        match self.flow_weights.find? key with
        | some w => if w >= threshold then acc.insert nid else acc
        | none => acc
      ) (Std.RBSet.empty (fun a b => a < b))

structure ChaosCoreKernel where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : DynamicTaskScheduler
  flow_analyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : Std.RBMap Nat ProcessingCore (fun a b => a < b)
  cycle_count : Nat
  migration_count : Nat
  allocator : Allocator
deriving Repr

def ChaosCoreKernel.init (allocator : Allocator) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { storage := ContentAddressableStorage.init allocator DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE
    scheduler := DynamicTaskScheduler.init allocator
    flow_analyzer := DataFlowAnalyzer.init allocator
    cores := Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b)
    cycle_count := 0
    migration_count := 0
    allocator := allocator }

def ChaosCoreKernel.addCore (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (core_id : Nat) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with cores := self.cores.insert core_id (ProcessingCore.init core_id) }

def ChaosCoreKernel.allocateMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (data : ByteArray) (preferred_core : Option Nat) (time : Int) : Except Unit (ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray) :=
  match self.storage.store self.allocator data preferred_core time with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (new_storage, block_id) =>
      Except.ok ({ self with storage := new_storage }, block_id)

def ChaosCoreKernel.readMemory (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Option (ByteArray × ChaosCoreKernel) :=
  match self.storage.retrieve block_id time with
  | some (data, new_storage) => some (data, { self with storage := new_storage })
  | none => none

def ChaosCoreKernel.createTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (priority : Int) (deps : List ByteArray) (est : Nat) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel × ByteArray :=
  let (new_sched, tid) := self.scheduler.submitTask self.allocator priority deps est time
  let tmp_task := TaskDescriptor.init self.allocator tid priority est
  let tmp_task_deps := deps.foldl (fun t d => t.addDependency self.allocator d) tmp_task
  let new_analyzer := self.flow_analyzer.buildFlowGraph self.allocator [tmp_task_deps]
  ({ self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer }, tid)

def ChaosCoreKernel.finishTask (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (task_id : ByteArray) (time : Int) : Bool × ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let new_sched := self.scheduler.completeTask self.allocator task_id time
  let existed := self.scheduler.active_tasks.contains task_id
  (existed, { self with scheduler := new_sched })

def ChaosCoreKernel.entangleData (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (block_id1 : ByteArray) (block_id2 : ByteArray) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  { self with storage := self.storage.entangleBlocks block_id1 block_id2 }

structure Migration where
  id : ByteArray
  target : Nat

def ChaosCoreKernel.optimizeDataPlacement (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let migrations := self.storage.storage.fold (fun acc _ block =>
    if block.state.toUInt8 == 3 then acc else
    let affinities := self.flow_analyzer.analyzeFlow block.block_id self.allocator
    if affinities.isEmpty then acc else
    let best := affinities.fold (fun (b_cid, b_val) cid val => if val > b_val then (cid, val) else (b_cid, b_val)) (0, -1.0)
    let best_core := best.1
    let best_affinity := best.2
    match block.affinity_core with
    | some current => if current != best_core && best_affinity > OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD then { id := block.block_id, target := best_core } :: acc else acc
    | none => acc
  ) []
  let (new_storage, mig_count) := migrations.foldl (fun (st, cnt) mig =>
      let st' := st.migrateBlock mig.id mig.target
      (st', cnt + 1)
  ) (self.storage, self.migration_count)
  { self with storage := new_storage, migration_count := mig_count }

def ChaosCoreKernel.balanceLoad (self : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let loads := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core => if core.state == 2 then acc else acc.insert cid core.getWorkload) (Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))
  if loads.isEmpty then self else
  let total := loads.fold (fun s _ v => s + v) 0.0
  let avg := total / Float.ofNat loads.size
  let overloaded := loads.fold (fun acc cid l => if l > avg * LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD then cid :: acc else acc) []
  let underloaded := loads.fold (fun acc cid l => if l < avg * LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD then (cid, l) :: acc else acc) []
  if overloaded.isEmpty || underloaded.isEmpty then self else
  let underloaded_sorted := underloaded.mergeSort (fun a b => a.2 < b.2)
  let under_ids := underloaded_sorted.map Prod.fst
  let (final_storage, final_mig) := overloaded.foldl (fun (st, mig) over_cid =>
      match st.affinity_map.find? over_cid with
      | none => (st, mig)
      | some blocks =>
          let blist := blocks.fold (fun l b => l ++ [b]) []
          if blist.isEmpty then (st, mig) else
          let count := max 1 (blist.length / 4)
          let capped := min count blist.length
          let rec loop (i : Nat) (cur_st : ContentAddressableStorage) (cur_mig : Nat) (u_idx : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage × Nat :=
             if i >= capped then (cur_st, cur_mig) else
             let target := under_ids.get! (u_idx % under_ids.length)
             let next_idx := u_idx + 1
             if target == over_cid then loop (i+1) cur_st cur_mig next_idx else
             let bid := blist.get! i
             let next_st := cur_st.migrateBlock bid target
             loop (i+1) next_st (cur_mig + 1) next_idx
          termination_by capped - i
          decreasing_by
             simp_wf
             apply Nat.sub_pos
             linarith
          loop 0 st mig 0
  ) (self.storage, self.migration_count)
  { self with storage := final_storage, migration_count := final_mig }

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeCycle (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let cycle := self.cycle_count + 1
  let (new_sched, scheduled_info) := self.scheduler.scheduleTask self.cores self.storage time
  let new_analyzer := match scheduled_info with
    | some (tid, cid) =>
        let task := new_sched.active_tasks.find? tid |>.get!
        task.data_dependencies.foldl (fun acc dep => acc.recordAccess self.allocator dep cid time) self.flow_analyzer
    | none => self.flow_analyzer
  
  let new_cores := self.cores.fold (fun acc cid core =>
      let is_active := match scheduled_info with | some (_, scid) => scid == cid | none => false
      acc.insert cid (core.tick is_active)
    ) self.cores
  
  let temp_kernel := { self with scheduler := new_sched, flow_analyzer := new_analyzer, cores := new_cores, cycle_count := cycle }
  let k_opt := temp_kernel.optimizeDataPlacement
  if k_opt.cycle_count % BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES == 0 then k_opt.balanceLoad else k_opt

  data : ByteArray

structure Edge where

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : Std.RBMap String Node (fun a b => a < b)

def ChaosCoreKernel.executeGraphOnKernel (self : ChaosCoreKernel) (graph : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (time : Int) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
  let rec_nodes (iter : List (String × Node)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b)) : ChaosCoreKernel × Std.RBMap String ByteArray (fun a b => a < b) :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (id, node) :: rest =>
        match acc.1.allocateMemory node.data none time with
        | Except.error _ => rec_nodes rest acc
        | Except.ok (k', bid) => rec_nodes rest (k', acc.2.insert id bid)
  termination_by iter.length
  decreasing_by
    simp_wf
    case _ => simp

  let (k', node_to_block) := rec_nodes graph.nodes.toList (self, Std.RBMap.empty (fun a b => a < b))

  let rec_edges (iter : List (Edge × Nat)) (acc : ChaosCoreKernel) : ChaosCoreKernel :=
    match iter with
    | [] => acc
    | (edge, _) :: rest =>
        let source_block := node_to_block.find? edge.source
        let target_block := node_to_block.find? edge.target
        match source_block, target_block with
        | some sb, some tb =>
            let k'' := acc.entangleData sb tb
            rec_edges rest k''
        | _, _ => rec_edges rest acc
  termination_by iter.length
